vignette.story: John is a young and enthusiastic gamer who enjoys playing online games with friends after school. Emily is a classmate of John's who also shares his passion for gaming and they often team up in multiplayer games. Emily messaged John on Messenger asking for help to log in to "Galactic Conquest," a game they both play, because she was having trouble with her own account. John checked his personal Notion notebook, which he had nicknamed "Game Vault," and found his gaming username "PixelWarrior87" and password that he uses for all his favorite online games. He also found his high scores and the list of games he wanted to recommend to Emily for their next gaming session, including "Mystic Quest" and "Zombie Frontier."
